source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U16: Separate process clocks, moratorium, withdrawal and professional appointment

payload.title: A process pause and a withdrawal need different authority
payload.core_explanation_md:
A CIRP moratorium is a statutory protection linked to its order and scope; it is not a general statement that all guarantees or every third-party asset are extinguished. The 2026 amendment expressly addresses the described surety recourse against the corporate debtor. Historic section10A relief also depends on the date the relevant default arose, not simply when someone later applies.

The amended withdrawal route uses the RP application with ninety-per-cent CoC voting approval, and bars withdrawal before CoC constitution or after the first invitation for resolution plans. A creditor agreement alone is not the complete withdrawal order. IRP/RP appointment and continuation likewise require the applicable route and records; an extension or replacement proposal is not already granted.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a private settlement alone complete statutory withdrawal?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Apply the operative application, voting, timing and order requirements.

payload.stem_md: A creditor asks for withdrawal after the first resolution-plan invitation and relies only on the old applicant wording. What must be reconciled?

options.text_md: Any private agreement overrides all statutory timing rules
options.explanation_md: Settlement cannot simply remove the amended conditions.

options.text_md: A demand notice automatically restores the old wording
options.explanation_md: Notice does not revive superseded text.

options.text_md: The amended12A applicant,CoC approval and timing restrictions
options.explanation_md: The operative version is material to the decision.

options.text_md: Only the original loan interest rate
options.explanation_md: Pricing does not determine withdrawal eligibility.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The operative version is material to the decision.

payload.stem_md: A default arises outside the protected historical section10A window, but the application is filed during a later year. Which date distinction matters?

options.text_md: The default-arising date and actual protected period
options.explanation_md: Application timing alone does not place a default in the protected window.
Software installation is not the statutory trigger.

options.text_md: Any date selected by the debtor
options.explanation_md: The legal event must be established by evidence.

options.text_md: The first year the bank used email
options.explanation_md: That event does not determine section10A scope.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Application timing alone does not place a default in the protected window.
